newsitem.title: USA: Rimage Corp begins shipping CD-R system.
newsitem.headline: Rimage Corp begins shipping CD-R system.

text.p: Rimage Corp said Thursday it began shipping its new Perfect Image Producer system, which is used to create compact disc-based software.
The updated system, which includes a CD printer and the necessary software, supports up to four CD-R recorders and up to four simultaneous data streams, Rimage said.
The system costs $20,950 for a single drive setup and $31,450 for a four-drive setup, the company said.
Rimage develops digital publishing and duplication systems for CD-R and diskette products.
